summary: The macOS 1.0 (4) remediation is verified: CI, README, SUPPORT, PRIVACY, and App Store metadata now consistently describe build 4; the Mac target excludes the local remote listener sources; and the exported app is arm64+x86_64, signed, versioned 1.0 (4), and free of network.server/network.client entitlements, Bonjour/local-network plist keys, and listener markers.
